column1: # Expected rows of the AL2023 product object-load run (G035 plan section 1c).

# the plan's identity and hygiene rows. One stream per (kernel, step,
# profile): results/<kernel>/<step>__<profile>.json. The judge keeps the
# rows of the -profiles set (PENDING D4); a "-" profile is always kept.
# Each row needs exactly one pass and no skip or fail; anything not listed
# here is an unexpected row and fails the run.
# build: GitHub-hosted runner, no special kernel.
# 6.12: the exact pinned build, as root (steps 0-4 and 6).
# 6.18: the exact pinned build, as root (steps 0-4 and 6).
# unpinned: any unpinned kernel (step 5): the runner's own kernel (EC2 lane)
# or the AL2023 image's default kernel (QEMU lane).
